rationale: This is essentially the archived MarketBookGapKnowledgeCover (fmb 5.31, alpha 0.043) with the goodwill-share subtraction from InternalKnowledgeBookValueQuality/GoodwillCleanBookValue bolted on and the additive-conditional wrapper from ReportedYieldHiddenCapitalResilience — a recombination of three already-tested archive elements rather than a new mechanism, and the two gap-share terms have inconsistent denominators so their difference is not a clean decomposition of the market-book gap.

The cash-conversion leg (oancf scaled by the pre-R&D earnings base) is a substantively different quality screen from the archived MIN-based CashBackedPreRDEarningsYield and is internally consistent with the stated hypothesis, though the |ib|+xrd denominator can blow up near zero and the oancf requirement will likely cut coverage to ~0.09, which is exactly where prior cash-flow variants lost their alpha.

This is a two-leg swap of the archived PriorKnowledgeCashPayoffValue (Δoancf → Δgross profit) crossed with the sales-to-price leg of CommercializingKnowledgeValue, and that specific sales-yield leg already produced a reliably *negative* FF5 alpha (−0.026, t=−2.55), so the proposal recombines the weakest tested ingredient with a near-standard gross-profitability-change variable.

Structurally identical to the already-failed GoodwillProductivityPremiumRisk (fmb −1.29) with both legs cosmetically swapped, and the Δgoodwill component is close to a direct rediscovery of the asset-growth/acquirer-underperformance anomaly rather than a novel cross-theme interaction.

With xad COALESCE'd to zero for the large majority of firms, this is numerically almost the same signal as the archived PayoutSupportedKnowledgeYield (fmb 5.78, alpha 0.052) and therefore a cosmetic extension whose incremental information comes from a sparse, self-selected advertising-reporting subsample.

Conditioning earnings yield on *within-firm* time-series R&D intensity rank is a genuinely new dimension in this archive (which has only used TS_COUNT, VOL, and one-year DELTA of xrd/sale), but the hypothesized direction directly contradicts the archived MatureRDCheapness result favoring *declining* intensity, and TS_RANK of an all-zero COALESCE'd series will lump non-R&D firms into an arbitrary conditioning bucket.
